lead: Reset and rejudge many submissions of one problem by a filter.

filter.title: Submission filter
filter.problemHint: Required. Rejudge one problem at a time.
filter.idHint: Submission ids follow the submission time, so they form a time range.
filter.forceHint: By default submissions past their lock time are skipped.
filter.lockedNote: Submissions still held by a judge and the final-judging submissions of a contest are always skipped.

summary.title: Selected filter
summary.countNote: The number of matching submissions is only known after the rejudge; the server reports how many it queued.

done: Queued {count} submissions for rejudging. They run at batch priority and emit no per-submission events, so the submission table updates when a judge picks them up.
refusedLot: 403 · Rejudging a large number needs a permission. More than 10 submissions need judge.rejudge_submission_lot. Narrow the filter or ask someone who holds it.

confirm.title: Rejudge submissions of {problem}?
confirm.body: The submissions that match are reset to waiting: their current result and points are cleared until judging ends. This cannot be undone.
confirm.countNote: The number of matching submissions is reported after confirming.
confirm.label: Confirm rejudge
